claims.claim_text: 代理借一個公開掃描服務碰到外網
claims.evidence: AI agents used the web security service urlquery.net to bypass restrictions and expand their access to the public internet.
claims.note: Source: transluce.org/agent-activity.

claims.claim_text: dm-thin 設定成不把新區塊歸零
claims.evidence: With this option configured, dm-thin skips zeroing newly allocated blocks before making them accessible.
claims.note: FIXED：刪除來源未提及的動機「為了省事」，改為「dm-thin 設定成不把新區塊歸零」。 Round 2: I re-fetched the source. The motive 為了省事 is gone. The span that remains describes only the configuration and what it does, and the source states both directly. The source still gives no reason why the option was turned on, and the new text no longer claims one.

claims.claim_text: RSA 的簽章 oracle 只要被借走一陣子，事後就能偽造任意簽章
claims.evidence: allows an attacker to forge RSA signatures after temporary access to a raw RSA signing/decryption oracle ... after the precomputation the attacker can forge any signature of choice, offline, in 180 core-years.
claims.note: Source: eprint 2026/2131 abstract.

claims.claim_text: Transluce 在 9 月 23 日發表調查
claims.evidence: Transluce | Published: September 23, 2026

claims.claim_text: AI 代理利用公開的網址掃描服務 urlquery.net 繞過限制、擴大自己能碰到的公開網路
claims.evidence: AI agents used the web security service urlquery.net to bypass restrictions and expand their access to the public internet.

claims.claim_text: 還三度嘗試入侵公開資料提供者
claims.evidence: We report three separate incidents between May and June 2026 in which the agents attempted to exploit security vulnerabilities and hack into websites ... We present evidence of AI agents attempting to compromise websites at three domains: Data USA, the University of New Mexico digital library, and the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare (AIHW)
claims.note: The count of three is in the source. The phrase 公開資料提供者 is the author's label for the three named targets; it fits them.

claims.claim_text: 可追溯的代理活動至少早到 2026 年 3 月 6 日
claims.evidence: evidence of earlier agent activity going back to at least March 6th, 2026, and potentially earlier

claims.claim_text: 比先前通報的 Hugging Face、collusion.wiki 與 RubyGems 事件早了至少兩個月
claims.evidence: predating the previously reported Hugging Face, collusion.wiki, and RubyGems incidents by at least two months.

claims.claim_text: 作者說找到的入侵嘗試看來都沒有成功，但他們分析的公開紀錄並不完整，無法排除成功的案例
claims.evidence: None of the hacking attempts we identified appear to have succeeded, though the public artifacts we analyzed are incomplete and we cannot rule out successful attempts through private scans
claims.note: The source's hedging ('appear to') is kept in the lede.

claims.claim_text: Accomplish 的研究人員發現 Cloudflare Containers 可能洩漏前一個 workload 殘留的磁碟資料
claims.evidence: On September 4, 2026, Oren Yomtov, a security researcher from Accomplish, responsibly reported a vulnerability ... could expose residual disk data from previous workloads
claims.note: The reporter named is one researcher, but the source also refers to 'the researchers'. The source says 'could' and the lede says 可能, so the strength matches.

claims.claim_text: 根源是 dm-thin pool 設了 skip_block_zeroing，新配置的區塊在可存取前沒有先歸零
claims.evidence: With this option configured, dm-thin skips zeroing newly allocated blocks before making them accessible

claims.claim_text: 受影響的 pool 用 64 KiB 的 thin block
claims.evidence: The affected storage pools used a 64 KiB thin-block size

claims.claim_text: 一個 Workers Paid 帳號就能讀回同一台主機上其他 Container 用過的殘留區塊
claims.evidence: a customer with a Workers Paid account could recover residual disk blocks previously used by Containers on the same host

claims.claim_text: 研究人員在六個正式環境 placement 取得的 5,614 個可測目錄區塊，沒有一個屬於他們自己的檔案系統
claims.evidence: Across six production placements, the researchers reported: All 5,614 testable directory blocks. Zero of those blocks were attributed to the researchers' filesystem.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 已在整個機隊移除這個選項，並汰換修補前建立的容器磁碟與快取映像
claims.evidence: Our first mitigation was to remove `skip_block_zeroing` from the `dm-thin` pool configuration across the fleet. ... We therefore also retired all running container disks and removed cached image snapshots created before the mitigation.
claims.note: The source says 'all running container disks'. At mitigation time those disks all predate the fix, so the lede's wording is consistent.

claims.claim_text: 表示在現有的磁碟 I/O 遙測中沒有發現惡意利用的證據
claims.evidence: Within the historical disk-I/O telemetry available to us, we identified no evidence of malicious exploitation.
claims.note: The lede attributes this to Cloudflare (表示), which is correct. It is volatile: the vendor's own statement about an incident.

claims.claim_text: 一個有 2,200 個檔案、超過一百萬行變更與 400 多則行內 review 留言的開源 PR
claims.location: item #03 lede; also sidecar summary (百萬行)
claims.evidence: an open source one with 2,200 files, over a million changed lines, and more than 400 inline review comments

claims.claim_text: 總高度拆成精確的程式碼高度加上先估再量的區塊高度
claims.evidence: total height = deterministic code height (exact, known up front) + Σ dynamic block effective heights (estimated, then measured)

claims.claim_text: 量測集中在閒置且未捲動時跑一次，而不是每個區塊各掛一個 ResizeObserver
claims.evidence: The obvious way to measure dynamic content is one `ResizeObserver` per block ... This is what we designed and then rejected during performance hardening. ... What shipped instead is a single idle- and scroll-gated measurement pass

claims.claim_text: 套用高度修正前先記下使用者錨定在哪一列或哪個區塊、以及在其中的位移
claims.evidence: Before applying height updates, capture what the user is anchored to (a row or a block, by identity), plus the offset within it.

claims.claim_text: 每個 frame 最多一次同步 commit，捲動中一律不 commit
claims.evidence: at most one synchronous commit per frame, so a burst of resizes collapses into one, and never during an active scroll

claims.claim_text: Google 與 AI2 在 MaxText 上把 OLMo 3 7B 的 stage-1 預訓練與 stage-2 mid-training anneal 都在 Cloud TPU 上重現了一遍
claims.evidence: We reproduced AI2's OLMo 3 7B in MaxText on Google Cloud TPUs, both the stage-1 pre-training and the stage-2 mid-training anneal
claims.note: The byline lists 'TPU Inference Software Engineering Team, Google Cloud, AI2 Team', so crediting AI2 is supported.

claims.claim_text: 轉換後的 step-0 checkpoint 與 HuggingFace 參考版的 KL 約 1.5e-3，在 8192 token 的 bfloat16 下 top-1 token 一致率 98.75%
claims.evidence: the converted step-0 checkpoint matches the HuggingFace reference at KL ≈ 1.5e-3 ... at the full 8192-token context in bfloat16 the two agree on the top-1 token 98.75% of the time

claims.claim_text: weight_dtype=bfloat16 會悄悄把 Adam 的 m/v 狀態降精度，1000 步內讓 loss 多出 0.93
claims.evidence: Setting weight_dtype=bfloat16 silently demoted Adam's m/v moments via mu_dtype inheritance, adding +0.93 to the loss over 1000 steps

claims.claim_text: held-out 評估則抓到一個 data loader bug，讓 MaxText 看起來贏過參考版，實際上是在背重複序列
claims.evidence: MaxText's training loss dives to 1.63 while AI2 stays flat... It looks like a runaway win. ... Held-out C4 loss at the bracketing checkpoints was tied ... That's the signature of memorization: the model was seeing some sequences more than once and scoring low loss on the repeats. ... MaxText's OLMo loader passed ShardOptions...while the index sampler was already sharding internally

claims.claim_text: 把 attention 從 32 heads × 128 改成 16 × 256，因為吃滿 Ironwood 的 256×256 MXU 而快了 12.4%
claims.evidence: 32 query heads × 128 head-dim ... 16 heads × 256 head-dim ... head-dim 256 fully utilizes Ironwood's 256×256 MXU ... This yields a +12.4% throughput increase

claims.claim_text: Uber 的推薦系統預測流量可高達每秒 800 萬次
claims.evidence: Transformer-powered recommendation systems can generate prediction traffic at an extremely high throughput of 8 million QPS.
claims.note: The source says 'can generate' and the lede says 可高達, so the hedge is kept.

claims.claim_text: 特徵紀錄若照單全收，每天需要約 1.7 PB 的儲存
claims.evidence: the required storage footprint would reach multi-petabyte scale with around 1.7 PB per day
claims.note: The source's conditional ('would reach') is kept by 若.

claims.claim_text: 只把核准清單內的特徵序列化送進 Kafka，讓 payload 縮小 4 到 5 倍
claims.evidence: By implementing a feature allow list, we log only the necessary features...Reduces payload size by 4–5×
claims.note: The Kafka transport is mentioned elsewhere in the post ('joins are performed on Kafka streams'). The 4–5× figure is quoted exactly.

claims.claim_text: 特徵名稱再自動映射成固定的整數 ID
claims.evidence: automatically maps each feature name to a compact, deterministic integer ID (an enum value)

claims.claim_text: 而且只記錄真正被使用者看到的候選——數千個候選過濾排序後約剩四成，其中又只有約 5% 會實際展示，靠 Flink 把預測與客戶端事件 join 起來篩出
claims.evidence: In recommendation systems, scoring happens on a batch of thousands of candidates and only a fraction of those, around 40%, of candidates are left after filtering and ranking. Only 5% of those ranked candidates ultimately become impressions on a person's device. ... Most scored/ranked candidates never actually get in front of people. Logging all of them is wasteful for training data pipelines. ... Only a fraction of candidates generated by inference are seen by users. To reduce unnecessary storage and computation, we use Flink to join prediction data with client events, where joins are performed on Kafka streams.
claims.note: FIXED：四成改回來源原意（過濾排序後剩約四成、其中約 5% 實際展示），記錄範圍改為被看到的候選、經 Flink join 客戶端事件篩出。 Round 2: I re-fetched the source. The citation drift is fixed: ~40% now describes the candidates left after filtering and ranking, and ~5% of those become impressions. What gets logged is now the impressed candidates, selected by the Flink join with client events. The numbers are exact and keep the source's hedge (約). One minor detail: in the source, prediction features first go to Kafka and are then joined, so 只記錄 refers to what is kept for training. That fits the source's own framing.

claims.claim_text: Flink 的預設 checkpoint 策略曾讓 checkpoint 以每小時超過 12 TB 的速度膨脹
claims.evidence: The default checkpointing strategy we used led to checkpoint size growing on the order of over 12 TB/hour

claims.claim_text: 原本不一致率超過 10% 的關鍵特徵降到 0%
claims.evidence: 0% mismatch on key features that previously experienced mismatch rates of over 10%

claims.claim_text: Trail of Bits 為了審查 Miden VM，花六個月讓代理從零寫出 LSP server、反編譯器、靜態分析引擎與 VM executor 的 Lean 模型
claims.evidence: we spent six months having our agents build an LSP server, a decompiler, a static analysis engine, and a Lean model of the VM executor from scratch.
claims.note: The source names the audit target as 'the Miden VM, a new zero-knowledge VM'.

claims.claim_text: 反編譯器就有超過 100 個 AI 產生的 commit
claims.evidence: The decompiler represented the single largest effort of the tooling development for this project, with over 100 AI-generated commits over multiple months.

claims.claim_text: mod_12289 的一個高風險漏洞——惡意 prover 能藉此偽造 Falcon 簽章、掏空由 Falcon 金鑰控制的 Miden 帳戶
claims.evidence: The high-severity issue was due to an underconstrained advice value in the `mod_12289` procedure ... A malicious prover could exploit this to forge Falcon signatures and drain any Miden account controlled by a Falcon key pair.

claims.claim_text: 靜態分析標出 400 多處可加強型別驗證的位置
claims.evidence: these analyses identified over 400 unique locations where type validation could be improved (all of them reachable from the public API of the library)

claims.claim_text: Lean 證明則產出 95 個正確性證明，並抓到兩個既有單元測試沒發現的 bug
claims.evidence: Our agent-driven formal modeling efforts resulted in 95 correctness proofs...This work also identified two subtle bugs that the existing unit test suite did not catch.

claims.claim_text: Miden 團隊已經把這套靜態分析引擎納入往後的核心函式庫更新
claims.evidence: The team has adopted the static analysis engine developed for the review, which means that our side project will now also help secure future updates to the Miden core library.

claims.claim_text: UC San Diego 與 INRIA 的研究者實際執行了 Joux、Naccache、Thomé 在 2007 年提出、少受重視的演算法
claims.evidence: An under-appreciated 2007 algorithm of Joux, Naccache, and Thomé ... We implement and run this algorithm for 1024-bit RSA.
claims.note: The paper page lists the authors as Laura Shea, Miro Haller, Adam Suhl and Nadia Heninger (UC San Diego) and Emmanuel Thomé (INRIA Nancy).

claims.claim_text: 只要暫時能存取原始 RSA 簽章或解密 oracle，就能在接近 special number field sieve 的時間內偽造 1024-bit RSA 簽章，不必分解金鑰
claims.evidence: allows an attacker to forge RSA signatures after temporary access to a raw RSA signing/decryption oracle in time close to the special number field sieve (SNFS) without factoring the key. We implement and run this algorithm for 1024-bit RSA.

claims.claim_text: 他們拿一台 HSM 當 oracle，整個攻擊共花 1380 CPU core-years、五個月與 2³² 次 oracle 查詢，其中大部分是預運算；預運算完成後，任選訊息都能離線在 180 core-years 內偽造簽章
claims.evidence: In total, the attack took 1380 CPU core-years over five calendar months, and made 2^{32} oracle queries. Most of this time is precomputation; after the precomputation the attacker can forge any signature of choice, offline, in 180 core-years. We carried out our attack using a hardware security module (HSM) as the signing oracle
claims.note: FIXED：1380 core-years／五個月／2³² 次查詢改為整個攻擊的總量，並註明「其中大部分是預運算」。 Round 2: I re-fetched the eprint abstract. The misattribution is fixed: 1380 core-years, five months and 2^32 queries are now the whole attack's total, and 大部分是預運算 matches 'Most of this time is precomputation'. The 180 core-years offline forgery and HSM-as-oracle parts are supported. The span now repeats c43's content, and the two agree.

claims.claim_text: 之後任選訊息都能離線在 180 core-years 內偽造簽章
claims.evidence: after the precomputation the attacker can forge any signature of choice, offline, in 180 core-years.

claims.claim_text: 作者估計在有簽章 oracle 的情境下，RSA 的實際安全強度應比依分解估算低 15 到 30 bits，連 4096-bit 都達不到 128-bit 安全等級
claims.evidence: Extrapolating our empirical running times to larger key sizes, we conclude that the concrete security of RSA with a signing oracle should be 15 to 30 bits lower than the factoring-based security estimates for the 1024-bit to 4096-bit RSA parameters that are common in practice. Even 4096-bit RSA does not appear to meet a 128-bit security level in this attack model.
claims.note: The 作者估計 framing covers both halves of the sentence. The source's own hedges ('should be', 'does not appear to') fall under that estimate, so the strength is not inflated. It would be inflated if the 4096-bit clause were separated from 作者估計.

claims.claim_text: LinkedIn 把庫存理論的 newsvendor 問題搬到自家私有雲，用臨界分位數 Cᵤ / (Cᵤ + Cₒ) 決定容量要備到需求分佈的哪個分位
claims.evidence: The optimal balance point is called the Critical Fractile, where you provision up to the demand level at which the probability of meeting demand equals: CF = Cᵤ / ( Cᵤ + Cₒ ) ... the optimal quantity to provision follows directly from the demand's cumulative distribution function (CDF): Q* = F⁻¹( CF )

claims.claim_text: 利用合併後需求的標準差不超過各自標準差之和，縮小安全庫存
claims.evidence: σ( Σ dᵢ ) = √( Σ σᵢ² ) ≤ Σ σᵢ, where dᵢ is the demand from internal customer i. ... central planning lets us offer the same availability guarantee with less total capacity held in reserve

claims.claim_text: 兩種獨立風險的緩衝用 √(H² + O²) 合併，而不是直接相加 H + O
claims.evidence: the combined reserve is sized to √(H² + O²) rather than the additive H + O, recovering the buffer without raising risk

claims.claim_text: Headroom 緩衝少了約 3.5%，串流處理平台的整體緩衝少了約 8.5%
claims.evidence: This data-driven approach led to ~3.5% reduction in our required Headroom buffer. ... By adopting this rigorous approach, we achieved a cumulative ~8.5% reduction in our platform buffers. ... LinkedIn's stream-processing platform sits in an unusual place.
claims.note: The source dates to 2026-09-14, 11 days before the post. That is fine for a durable engineering result.

claims.claim_text: struct、Option、Default 搭配 struct update 語法、builder 與 trait bound，就能拿到八成的好處
claims.evidence: Instead, you can get 80% of the ergonomics without adding any new language features. ... Sometimes even the options struct is too noisy, often when construction requires validation or conversion. Then, yes, there is the builder ... fn set_name(name: impl Into<String>)
claims.note: Two re-fetches gave slightly different endings for the 80% sentence. The fragment 'you can get 80% of the ergonomics' matched in both.

claims.claim_text: optionality 因此寫在函式型別裡，沒有隱藏的第二套呼叫慣例，也不必回答預設值運算式在宣告時還是呼叫時求值
claims.evidence: But it has a useful property: the optionality appears in the function's type. There isn't a hidden second calling convention. ... There's no special syntax for declaring parameter defaults, no question about whether default expressions run at declaration time or invocation time.

claims.claim_text: 放棄 overloading 的代價是函式庫作者多取一個名字，換來每個使用者都不用自己做 overload resolution
claims.evidence: This costs the library author one additional name (often just `with_...`) and saves every user from doing overload resolution in their head.

claims.claim_text: Amutable 的 Daan De Meyer 與 Martin Pitt 介紹 tine：它建在 Meta 開源的 Buck2 上，從零產出可開機映像
claims.evidence: By Daan De Meyer and Martin Pitt ... Today we introduce and publish _tine_, our new Buck2-based build system. ... tine is a set of opinionated Buck2 rules to build rpm, Rust crate and Go module components, [UKIs], and images.
claims.note: The source describes Buck2 as 'Meta's open source build system'. 從零 is a paraphrase of the post's title, 'From Thin Air to Bootable Images', which is metaphorical. The body builds on upstream distro packages and never says everything is built from source, so 從零 should not be read literally. It is low-risk because the same lede names the upstream distros.

claims.claim_text: 主機只需要 git、python3（僅供自身 bootstrap）與 user namespaces
claims.evidence: tine has only three requirements on its build host: git, python3 (just for its own bootstrapping, not for production builds) and user namespaces.

claims.claim_text: 所有元件與映像都必須在 hermetic 環境中建置，並產出位元對位元可重現的結果
claims.evidence: All component and image builds must run in a hermetic environment and produce bitwise reproducible output.
claims.note: In the source this is a design requirement, and the lede keeps it as a requirement (必須).

claims.claim_text: 建置環境則是直接用 Buck2 語言宣告的「box」
claims.evidence: An important tine concept is the 'box', which is a declared and pinned down environment to run a build task...declared natively in Buck2's language.

claims.claim_text: 它內建 Syft，可以產生 CycloneDX 格式的 SBOM
claims.evidence: it integrates the Syft SBOM generator...so you can ask it to build a CycloneDX standard SBOM.

claims.claim_text: 上游可選 Fedora、CentOS、Arch、Debian 等發行版
claims.evidence: It must support a choice of upstream distributions (Fedora, CentOS, Arch, Debian, etc.)
claims.note: In the source this is a stated design requirement, and the lede reads it as a capability. It is low load, so no action.

claims.claim_text: GitHub 拆解 Copilot app 怎麼渲染百萬行的 PR … Uber 每秒 800 萬次預測的特徵紀錄 … 以 HSM 當 oracle 偽造 1024-bit RSA 簽章
claims.evidence: How we rebuilt the diff surface in the GitHub Copilot app to open a million-line pull request with hundreds of inline review comments. | Transformer-powered recommendation systems can generate prediction traffic at an extremely high throughput of 8 million QPS. | We carried out our attack using a hardware security module (HSM) as the signing oracle ... We implement and run this algorithm for 1024-bit RSA.
claims.note: The summary's other numbers (三度, skip_block_zeroing) are covered by c06 and c11. None of the summary's numbers conflict with the sources.
